title: introduce-provenance-backed-changelog-templates-and-versioned-metrics
author: Maya Patel
description: Adds a provenance-first changelog generator and a compact versioned_metrics schema to make release notes reproducible and machine-readable. Motivation: model onboards and performance profile changes currently produce free-form release notes that are hard to diff, verify, and consume by downstream tooling (console, release summaries, SDK release hooks). This PR introduces a templated changelog writer that consumes existing provenance fields (uploader, model_digest, dataset_manifest, profile_snapshot_id) and the new versioned_metrics bundle (a small JSON blob with named metrics + sample metadata). Key features: 1) changelog templates stored in templates/changelogs/*.tmpl and a CLI command mr-changelog generate --model MODEL_ID --from SNAPSHOT --to SNAPSHOT that emits both human and compact machine summary; 2) versioned_metrics schema and migration that stores per-profile metric names, units, aggregation window, and a provenance stamp; 3) automatic inclusion of a minimal delta section that lists metric-level deltas and quality regressions with links to evaluation artifacts; 4) hooks that allow the model onboarding flow to opt-in to auto-drafting a changelog and attach the generated artifact to the model version; 5) test coverage for generator logic and a small e2e workflow used in CI. Backwards compatibility: existing changelog text fields are preserved and the generator will fall back to the legacy narrative when provenance is incomplete. The migration is additive and guarded behind a feature flag 'versioned_metrics_enabled' to allow staged rollout. This description includes a high-level commit summary and review notes below.

Priya Singh: The default template is wordy for release notes; can we add an option to produce a one-line summary for dashboards?

Diego Ramos: CI e2e failed on first run due to a timing issue when attaching artifacts. Suggest retry logic and metrics in logs.

release_notes: Adds a provenance-aware changelog generator and an optional versioned_metrics payload for model profile releases. Includes CLI tooling (mr-changelog), templates, migration, and docs. Rollout guarded by feature flag 'versioned_metrics_enabled'.
